title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @IFM_AI：Today’s LLMs still write like typewriters: one token at a time. This sequential process creates a hard inference bottlen
items.abstract_or_text: Today’s LLMs still write like typewriters: one token at a time. This sequential process creates a hard inference bottleneck. We're introducing Uno, a diffusion-augmented LLM that delivers autoregressive quality at diffusion speed. It’s a lossless speedup method that accelerates generation without degrading response quality. With Uno, K2-Horizon-7B outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion methods in both quality and throughput, delivering up to a 2.2× speedup with no loss in quality. Paper: https://t.co/VSLsf01oBo Model available at:
items.summary_zh: Institute of Foundation Models 介绍 Uno，并称其以扩散式生成实现对自回归语言模型的无损加速；帖文报告 K2-Horizon-7B 在质量和吞吐量上优于既有扩散方法，最高提速2.2倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是对生成延迟瓶颈给出明确技术路径、指标与论文入口的原始机构发布，值得关注；性能结论仍应以论文和可复现实验为准。
evidence_flags: 性能结论来自机构帖文，需以论文复核
items.abstract_zh: 如今的 LLM 仍像打字机一样：一次写出一个 token。这一串行过程造成了硬性的推理瓶颈。我们正在推出 Uno——一种经扩散增强的 LLM，以扩散速度提供自回归质量。这是一种无损加速方法，可在不降低响应质量的情况下加快生成。借助 Uno，K2-Horizon-7B 在质量和吞吐量两方面均优于最先进的扩散方法，在不损失质量的情况下最高实现 2.2 倍加速。论文：https://t.co/VSLsf01oBo 模型可获取于：

items.title: @_sophia_tang_：Can we train a one-step discrete generator without a teacher model? Introducing Discrete Beckmann Transport Models 🛸 — a
items.abstract_or_text: Can we train a one-step discrete generator without a teacher model? Introducing Discrete Beckmann Transport Models 🛸 — a new family of discrete generative models that provably carries any point in the latent space to a fixed point on the vertices of the simplex in a single step. We achieve the diversity-coherence Pareto frontier for unconditional language modeling and SOTA few-step reasoning performance, with 84.6% accuracy in 4 NFEs on Sudoku-Hard and 16.8% in 32 NFEs on TinyGSM/GSM8K. Joint work with @ShiyiWangML from my visit at Harvard!
items.summary_zh: Sophia Tang 发布与 Shiyi Wang 合作的 Discrete Beckmann Transport Models：作者称该离散生成模型可在一步内把潜在空间中的任一点送至单纯形顶点，并报告语言建模和少步推理的结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：帖文提供了具体模型构想、理论主张和任务指标，属于有实质信息的研究者一手发布；“可证明”和性能比较应回到论文核验。
evidence_flags: 作者性能陈述，需以论文复核
items.abstract_zh: 能否在没有教师模型的情况下训练一步式离散生成器？我们推出 Discrete Beckmann Transport Models 🛸——一类新的离散生成模型，可证明地在单一步骤中将潜在空间中的任一点运送到单纯形顶点上的一个固定点。我们在无条件语言建模中实现了多样性—连贯性的帕累托前沿，并取得了最先进的少步推理性能：在 Sudoku-Hard 上以 4 次 NFE 达到 84.6% 准确率，在 TinyGSM/GSM8K 上以 32 次 NFE 达到 16.8%。这是我在哈佛访问期间与 @ShiyiWangML 的合作工作！

items.title: @Letian_Wang_6：Earlier, quite a few people who attended CVPR told me they came away pretty disappointed — including some extremely seni
items.abstract_or_text: Earlier, quite a few people who attended CVPR told me they came away pretty disappointed — including some extremely senior people in the field. At the time, I didn’t fully understand why. But after I attended ECCV, I finally did. There was a surprising amount of frustration at the conference, especially since it happened right after the GPT-6 release. People were openly wondering what traditional CV research is going to look like from here, and how much of it will eventually just be absorbed by large foundation models.
items.summary_zh: Letian Wang 基于自己在 ECCV 的经历及与会者反馈，描述了传统计算机视觉研究在大模型发展背景下的焦虑，并提出其可能被基础模型吸收的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这不是事实结论，而是一位研究者对学科定位与研究议程变化的具名观察；它为专业社群讨论视觉研究的独立问题、方法和评价标准提供了切口。
evidence_flags: 作者观察，不构成领域趋势的独立证据
items.abstract_zh: 此前，不少参加过 CVPR 的人告诉我，他们离开时相当失望，其中包括一些领域内资深人士。当时我并不完全理解原因。但在我参加 ECCV 后，我终于明白了。会上有出人意料多的挫败感，尤其因为会议紧接着 GPT-6 发布之后举行。人们公开地在问：从现在起，传统计算机视觉研究会是什么样子，其中又有多少最终会被大型基础模型吸收。

items.title: @james_y_zou：Super excited that #VirtualBiotech is published in @ScienceMagazine today! Tens of thousands of AI scientist agents work
items.abstract_or_text: Super excited that #VirtualBiotech is published in @ScienceMagazine today! Tens of thousands of AI scientist agents work together across drug discovery + development, from target discovery to clinical trial design. Our blueprint for agentic R&D 🧵
items.summary_zh: James Zou 宣布 VirtualBiotech 当日在《Science》发表，并称该项目提出了让大量 AI 科学家智能体覆盖从靶点发现到临床试验设计的药物研发蓝图。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是作者对正式研究发布的直接说明，涉及智能体化研发的端到端组织方式；候选文本未给出方法和验证细节，不能据此推断体系已具备临床有效性。
evidence_flags: 作者宣布正式发表；候选文本未提供方法或验证细节
items.abstract_zh: 非常激动，#VirtualBiotech 今天发表于 @ScienceMagazine！数以万计的 AI 科学家智能体在药物发现与开发的各环节协同工作，从靶点发现到临床试验设计。我们关于智能体化研发的蓝图 🧵

items.title: @AnthropicAI：AI systems are getting more powerful, and they're increasingly being used to build the next version of themselves. We wa
items.abstract_or_text: AI systems are getting more powerful, and they're increasingly being used to build the next version of themselves. We want to illuminate that progress for the public. Today, we're sharing three measurements that help track AI development: 1. How much AI R&D is done by AI. 2. How well AI agents are overseen. 3. How compute is allocated. We provide a snapshot of these metrics from inside Anthropic. Any frontier developer could publish the same measures, and third parties could verify them. As the world considers pacing the frontier, we should do everything possible to minimize the gap between what frontier labs know and what the public knows. This means better measuring the development of AI, publishing our findings, and giving society an opportunity to decide how to use this information. Read the full post and methodology:
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 公布三项用于追踪 AI 发展进程的内部指标：AI 完成 AI 研发的比例、对 AI 智能体的监督水平，以及算力分配；该机构同时主张前沿开发者和第三方可采用或核验这些指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：相较泛泛的能力叙述，这是一项可讨论披露口径与外部核验条件的具体治理提案；指标的代表性及可验证性仍有待公开方法与第三方实践检验。
evidence_flags: 方法与第三方可验证性待核验
items.abstract_zh: AI 系统正变得更强大，而且越来越多地被用于构建它们自身的下一个版本。我们希望让公众了解这一进展。今天，我们分享三项有助于追踪 AI 发展的测量指标：1. 有多少 AI 研发由 AI 完成。2. AI 智能体被监督得如何。3. 算力如何分配。我们提供了这些指标在 Anthropic 内部的一个快照。任何前沿开发者都可以发布同样的测量结果，第三方也可以核验它们。当世界在考虑如何为前沿发展设定节奏时，我们应尽一切可能缩小前沿实验室所知与公众所知之间的差距。这意味着更好地测量 AI 发展、公布我们的发现，并让社会有机会决定如何使用这些信息。阅读完整文章和方法学：

items.title: @emollick：The state of public AI benchmarking is dire and is undermining our ability to understand how good AI is now. Most famous
items.abstract_or_text: The state of public AI benchmarking is dire and is undermining our ability to understand how good AI is now. Most famous measures are maxed out, and, as this paper shows, the non-saturated benchmarks are riddled with so many errors that they vastly underestimate AI abilities.
items.summary_zh: Ethan Mollick 认为公共 AI 基准的状态严峻：知名指标已趋于饱和，而未饱和基准存在大量错误，因而可能显著低估当前 AI 能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是围绕评测有效性、基准污染与能力测量的实质性观点，并明确援引论文；它是作者判断，不应替代对所引论文和各类基准的逐项审计。
evidence_flags: 作者引用论文，候选文本未含论文内容
items.abstract_zh: 公共 AI 基准的状况很糟，这正在削弱我们理解当下 AI 究竟有多强的能力。大多数著名指标都已饱和；而正如这篇论文所示，未饱和的基准充满了如此多的错误，以至于它们大幅低估了 AI 的能力。

items.title: @Thom_Wolf：Happy to start collaborating with @baselabs from @baseten and @GoodfireAI to push safety and interpretability for open m
items.abstract_or_text: Happy to start collaborating with @baselabs from @baseten and @GoodfireAI to push safety and interpretability for open models. As open-source models catch up in performance to frontier models, the community at large have a great opportunity to establish a common practice for effective safety, security and interpretability research. Some past discussions confused “open” with “unmonitored”. On the contrary, an open model provides much more tooling and visibility for safety research from a broader audience, which has led to a lot of the safety and security techniques we use today. Linux is a great example of this: open-source and secure deployment are not only compatible but heavily intertwined, as a properly secure system needs an extensive feedback loop of finding and fixing vulnerabilities. We're excited to share more soon.
items.summary_zh: Thomas Wolf 宣布将与 Baseten 和 GoodfireAI 合作推进开放模型的安全与可解释性研究；他主张“开放”不等于“不受监控”，并以 Linux 的漏洞反馈机制说明开放与安全部署可相互促进。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：帖文提出了可被反驳和检验的安全研究立场，而非单纯发布合作消息；其类比和结论属于作者观点，仍需结合具体模型、威胁模型与部署证据讨论。
items.abstract_zh: 很高兴开始与来自 @baseten 的 @baselabs 和 @GoodfireAI 合作，推动开放模型的安全性和可解释性。随着开源模型在性能上追赶前沿模型，更广泛的社群有很好的机会为有效的安全、安全性与可解释性研究建立共同实践。一些过去的讨论把“开放”与“未被监控”混为一谈。恰恰相反，开放模型为更广泛的受众提供了更多安全研究工具和可见性，这催生了我们今天使用的许多安全与安全防护技术。Linux 是很好的例子：开源与安全部署不仅兼容，而且高度交织，因为一个真正安全的系统需要广泛的发现并修复漏洞的反馈循环。我们很高兴很快分享更多内容。

items.title: @LiamFedus：We check OOD generalization for @periodiclabs Neon and report optimal cost-performance here, too. This indicates useful
items.abstract_or_text: We check OOD generalization for @periodiclabs Neon and report optimal cost-performance here, too. This indicates useful generalization for our model. But our experimental data also opens up an interesting ML research program. For example, RL tasks to directly predict experimental outcomes given all prior experimental data known up until that date.
items.summary_zh: Liam Fedus 称团队检查了 Periodic Labs Neon 的分布外泛化和成本—性能表现，并提出其实验数据还可支持一种按时间截断历史实验数据、直接预测实验结果的强化学习研究任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该帖把模型评估与实验数据的时间因果约束联系起来，提出了具体且可操作的机器学习研究问题；泛化与最优成本—性能的结论为作者自述，需查验完整评测。
evidence_flags: 作者自述，需以完整实验与评测复核
items.abstract_zh: 我们检查了 @periodiclabs Neon 的分布外泛化，也在这里报告了最优的成本—性能表现。这表明我们的模型具有有用的泛化能力。但我们的实验数据也开启了一个有趣的机器学习研究计划。例如，构建强化学习任务：在给定截至该日期已知的所有既往实验数据的条件下，直接预测实验结果。

items.title: @AnthropicAI：Biologists use specialized open-source models for tasks like modeling the structure of molecular systems, designing drug
items.abstract_or_text: Biologists use specialized open-source models for tasks like modeling the structure of molecular systems, designing drug-like molecules, and predicting the effects of genetic mutations. But these models are often expensive to run, potentially limiting their impact. In our latest Science Blog, we share how Claude was able to optimize inference for more than 30 open-source models, making them 4x faster on average, partly by writing custom software for GPUs. We’re open sourcing all of the optimization code. Read more:
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 称 Claude 为30多个开源生物学模型优化了推理，其中部分通过编写定制 GPU 软件实现，平均速度提升4倍，并将全部优化代码开源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是一项同时给出应用范围、量化结果和代码开放承诺的机构工程发布；平均4倍加速及适用边界应由所述技术博客和开源代码独立复现。
evidence_flags: 开源代码与性能结果待独立复现
items.abstract_zh: 生物学家使用专门的开源模型来完成诸如建模分子系统结构、设计类药分子和预测基因突变影响等任务。但这些模型的运行成本往往很高，可能限制其影响力。在我们最新的 Science Blog 中，我们分享了 Claude 如何能够为30多个开源模型优化推理，使其平均速度提高4倍，部分是通过为 GPU 编写定制软件。我们将把所有优化代码开源。阅读更多：

items.title: @mirrokni：I am happy to share our technical report on a multi-agent harness that helped us prove several new results and author pa
items.abstract_or_text: I am happy to share our technical report on a multi-agent harness that helped us prove several new results and author papers with long proofs over the past couple of months—and we've already released a variant of it as part of the /teamwork-preview feature in AntiGravity: https://t.co/3co2mUD4vs Our paper, "Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science," details a model-agnostic workflow that separates strategy exploration, proof decomposition, subproblem solving, and global verification. A few highlights from our evaluations: • Constructed complex research artifacts (as featured in the AGY blog post for /teamwork), including long proofs for a simpler construction of Knuth's Conjecture and proofs resulting in six other papers—all verified by the authors and/or via Lean. • Achieved a Codeforces score of 4263, surpassing the highest human score to date of 4059. • Reached a score of 71.0% on TCS-Bench (which we released last month), a challenging suite of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from venues like FOCS, STOC, and SODA, using a combination of Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. We have also integrated the Colosseum workflow into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the "Long Proof" pattern.
items.summary_zh: Vahab Mirrokni 发布 Stellar Colosseum 技术报告，介绍将策略探索、证明分解、子问题求解与全局验证分离的多智能体研究框架，并报告长证明、Codeforces 和 TCS-Bench 的评估结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是研究作者给出工作流、验证方式和量化评估的实质性一手说明，特别适合讨论多智能体研究系统的可验证产物；具体分数和证明贡献仍应以技术报告、Lean记录及作者核验为准。
evidence_flags: 作者自述；评测和证明核验需回到技术报告
items.abstract_zh: 我很高兴分享我们的技术报告：一个多智能体框架在过去几个月帮助我们证明了若干新结果，并撰写了包含长证明的论文；我们还已将其一个变体作为 AntiGravity 中 /teamwork-preview 功能的一部分发布：https://t.co/3co2mUD4vs。我们的论文《Stellar Colosseum：用于数学和理论计算机科学长程研究的多智能体框架》详细介绍了一种与模型无关的工作流，它将策略探索、证明分解、子问题求解和全局验证分开。评估中的几个亮点：• 构建了复杂研究产物（如 AGY 的 /teamwork 博客文章所展示），包括对 Knuth 猜想一个更简单构造的长证明，以及产生另外六篇论文的证明——全部由作者和/或通过 Lean 验证。• 达到 4263 的 Codeforces 分数，超过此前最高人类分数 4059。• 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 的组合，在 TCS-Bench 上达到 71.0% 的分数；该基准是我们上月发布的一个具有挑战性的研究级定理证明任务集，题目来自 FOCS、STOC 和 SODA 等会议。我们还已将 Colosseum 工作流作为“Long Proof”模式整合到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中。

review.note: 完整审阅60项候选后，按质量分≥65保留10项；已排除招聘、营销、无上下文短评、转发式概述及跨日已报道身份。X帖文来自Grok检索缓存，仅代表所检索到的公开帖文范围。
